name: Tenneco Texas Deepwater Link

values.EndLocation: West Cameron Block 167 (High Island Offshore System interconnection)

researcher_notes: Completed offshore lateral (EIA: Completed, in service 2001, historical sheet row 185 of the Aug 2026 release, project name 'Tenneco Texas Deepwater Link', FERC docket CP00-441). No tracker row: checked all 529 US gas rows; only Tennessee Gas Pipeline system rows P0259 and expansion rows P2496/P2497/P5600/P5601/P7802 exist, none is this lateral; Garden Banks P0192 is a different line. Class new_row in expansion shape under parent PipelineName 'Tennessee Gas Pipeline' (P0259). Independent confirmation: Federal Register notice of 28 Aug 2000 (FERC prior-notice request under CP00-441) states 17.8 miles of 20-inch pipe from Line 507K-200 in West Cameron 180, offshore Louisiana, to the HIOS interconnection in West Cameron 167, 700 MMcf/d capability, estimated cost $14,485,000. Oil & Gas Journal item describes a 17.5-mile, 20-inch, 400 MMcf/d line. EIA gives 400 MMcf/d and cost 15 (millions); capacity staged as EIA/OGJ 400, FERC design capability 700 noted. 17.8 mi is about 28.6 km, over the 25 km floor. Despite the EIA name it is offshore Louisiana federal waters, not Texas. Owner is EIA operator Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co (exact gazetteer hit); Parent left blank, 2000 parent (El Paso) not verified against current tracker style. Route not researched: no official GIS found, so no route. Ref for OGJ capacity read via search snippet plus url_verifier hit on '400' and '20-in'; page text not read in full. Tier high (EIA plus FERC notice). Note: this is a 2001 in-service line never captured, not a new proposal, so it is a backfill addition.
